evidence.title: Claude Design | Turn ideas into design | Claude by Anthropic

name: Claude Design
summary: Prompt-driven design surface inside Claude that builds on-brand visuals, slides and one-pagers.
description: Describe a visual and Claude builds a first version you can refine with comments, layout controls and adjustment sliders. It imports your design system from GitHub, design files or a local codebase, exports to PDF, PowerPoint and HTML, and connects to apps such as Adobe, Canva and HubSpot.
contains: describe a visual and get an on-brand first version to refine
design system import from GitHub, design files or a local codebase
moves between Claude Design and Claude Code (/design, /design-sync)
comment on elements, edit text, tune spacing and color with sliders
export to PDF, PowerPoint and HTML
connectors include Adobe, Canva, HubSpot, Gamma, Miro, Wix, Vercel
